purpose: Invalidate decision authority when any material execution dependency or evidence input becomes stale, contradictory, unavailable, or unverified.
rules: Every consequential action declares all material dependencies.
Each volatile dependency declares evidence, scope, observation time and freshness lease.
Expired, contradictory, unavailable or missing dependency evidence becomes UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN material dependencies block dependent authoritative actions.
Every material execution or verification receipt invalidates the affected OBS layers before the next action.
Only affected OBS layers are recomputed when dependency scope is safely localizable.
A valid proof-producing action that survives revalidation executes immediately; OBS work itself receives zero progress credit.
